name: Monster Ghoul(MOBILE/PC)[2X EXP][FIXED STAT][BETA]
desc:
Welcome to Monster Ghoul, an immersive experience where your choices shape your destiny. In this thrilling universe, you are invited to choose your allegiance:
 will you walk the path of the Ghouls or align yourself with the CCG (Commission of Counter Ghoul).


FAQ

-Killing player with high level could possibly earn high reputation

For computers press 1 to 9 to use your kagune/quinque 

"V" - Quinx or Arata Joker
"X" - Sprint


⚠️XBOX is still beta⚠️

XBOX CONTROLER LIST👇

Hold L2 + Square = E

Hold L2 + Triangle = R

Hold L2 + Cycle = F 

Hold L2 + X = C

Hold L2 + L1 = V

HoldL2 + Up Button = Switch Detahcments/QuinX

R2 = normal click

R1 = dash

Up button = Sprint

Down button = shiftlock

Left button = N (Equip Arata)

Right button = Mask


Normal X = Jump


Do not attempt to exploit the system, as our auto-detection will identify such actions, and we do not entertain appeals for bans.
